items.name: Pomodoro
items.note: One task, no switching. After four rounds take a longer break.

items.name: Long Pomodoro
items.note: For work that needs a longer run-up.

items.name: 52 and 17
items.note: Work with full attention, then really step away.

items.name: 90-minute cycle
items.note: Ride one natural energy wave, then rest properly.

items.name: Deep work
items.note: One hard thing, phone out of reach, notifications off.

items.name: Sprint
items.note: When starting feels hard: just ten minutes.

items.name: Two-minute rule
items.note: If it takes two minutes, do it now instead of listing it.
